semiconductor_relevance: High — Beijing Doublink Solders Co., Ltd. specializes in bonding wires and materials essential for semiconductor packaging and integrated circuit applications.
summary: Beijing Doublink Solders Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise that produces bonding wires made from gold, copper, silver, aluminum, and alloys for integrated circuits and semiconductor devices. The company focuses on R&D and has the capacity to produce 1 billion meters of bonding wire annually, catering to the electronic packaging sector.
capabilities: Gold, copper, silver, and aluminum bonding wires for semiconductor devices
Gold and gold alloy sectors for evaporation
Production of bonding wire with advanced production and detection equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is registered in Zhongguancun Science Park and has a significant manufacturing presence in China.
